title: Characterizing GitHub Security Actions Alerts For Web Application Tutorials
abstract: arXiv:2611.23967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The high frequency of cybersecurity incidents involving web applications highlights the importance of secure software development practices. Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools help identify potential vulnerabilities in source code without executing the code. Integrating SAST tools into GitHub Security Actions enables security alerts to be reported during development. However, the characteristics of these alerts can make them difficult for developers with limited security expertise to understand, prioritize, and address. Many tutorials for learning web application development also involve source code with security implications. We investigated the properties of SAST alerts relevant to this learning context. We analyzed 6,609 alerts from four default GitHub Security Actions configurations across 60 Django and Spring tutorial repositories. We evaluated the alerts along four dimensions: alert volume, alert relevance, conceptual

translated_title: 针对Web应用教程的GitHub安全操作警报特征分析
translated_abstract: 涉及Web应用的网络安全事件的高频发生凸显了安全软件开发实践的重要性。静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具可以在不执行代码的情况下帮助识别源代码中的潜在漏洞。将SAST工具集成到GitHub Security Actions中，可以在开发过程中报告安全警报。然而，这些警报的特性可能使安全专业知识有限的开发人员难以理解、确定优先级并加以处理。许多用于学习Web应用开发的教程也涉及具有安全影响的源代码。我们调查了与此学习场景相关的SAST警报的属性。我们分析了来自四个默认GitHub Security Actions配置的6,609条警报，这些警报来自60个Django和Spring教程仓库。我们从四个维度对警报进行了评估：警报数量、警报相关性、概念性……
tldr: 本研究分析了60个Django和Spring教程仓库中来自四种默认GitHub Security Actions配置的6,609条SAST安全警报，从警报数量、相关性等多个维度刻画了Web应用开发学习场景中安全警报的特征。
en_tdlr: This study characterizes 6,609 SAST alerts from 60 Django and Spring tutorial repositories across four default GitHub Security Actions configurations, analyzing alert volume, relevance, and other dimensions in the context of learning web application development.
